items.label: S2: dump post
items.description: Write the data of this post to the app log

items.label: S3: app comments and removes this post
items.description: The app writes a comment on this post and removes it, so that the events of the app account are logged

items.label: S2: dump listings
items.description: Write the 25 newest posts and the 25 posts of the mod queue to the app log

items.label: S3: probe platform
items.description: Write the headers, the settings, the app user and the result of two Redis set calls with nx to the app log

items.label: S4: WebAssembly and Redis
items.description: Time WebAssembly and the Redis reads; write the results to the app log

items.label: S4: decode this post
items.description: Fetch the image of this post, decode it, and write the times and the memory to the app log

fetchProbe.label: S6: fetch probe
fetchProbe.helpText: When on, the app fetches the smallest image of each post that it logs, and logs the answer. The fetch works only after Reddit approved the domains.

probeSelect.label: S3: select probe
probeSelect.helpText: Choose B, then run the menu item S3: probe platform. The app logs the form of the value.
